option_explanations.A: Correct. 23 out of 33 is roughly 70 percent; 15 out of 25 is 60 percent.
option_explanations.B: Wrong. The math is off: 25 to 10 is a 60 percent decline, not 70 percent.
option_explanations.C: Wrong. Ending at the same number does not mean the same relative decline, because the starting levels differ.
option_explanations.D: Wrong. Comparing raw point drops ignores the different starting levels; the question asks about the change relative to each starting level.

options: (A) Union membership: it fell from about 33 percent to about 10 percent, roughly a 70 percent drop.
(B) Manufacturing's share: it fell from about 25 percent to about 10 percent, roughly a 70 percent drop.

(D) Manufacturing's share, because a 25-point drop is larger than a 23-point drop.
